name: Ascoli Satriano (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of yellow and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Ascoli Satriano (a yellow lion on blue above green hills) within branches, with the motto S.P.Q.A. on a scroll.
history: Municipal flag of Ascoli Satriano, a comune in Apulia; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Ascoli Satriano arms — yellow lion on blue above green hills, crowned, within branches, with scroll S.P.Q.A.
